claim: An over-wide preflop 3-bet range should use more postflop checks than a stronger baseline range; failing to compensate makes the betting branch too weak.
interpretation: Postflop decisions must remain consistent with the actual preflop range shape rather than the label '3-bettor'. The compensation mechanism is source-supported, while the exact stack depth of the reviewed solver node is not source-locked in the current evidence package.
assumptions: Villain does not fully compensate by checking more
exceptions: Some boards still strongly favour the 3-bettor
The adjustment shrinks when Villain compensates correctly
Exact depth-specific frequencies require the source visuals
depth_scope: Directional mechanism only; exact stack depth is not source-locked in the current evidence package
notes: Compensation mechanism admitted. Exact board cards, suits, stack depth, sizes, frequencies and EV remain visual-dependent.

claim: Dry high-card and paired flops can preserve enough premium-range advantage for frequent small betting, while coordinated middling flops require a more selective strategy.
interpretation: The learner should test whether the preflop range advantage survived the actual board before choosing a wide or selective betting plan.
assumptions: Board interaction is evaluated at range level
exceptions: Exact board classes and frequencies require visual review
Opponent-specific range construction can change ownership
notes: No fixed size or frequency is admitted.

claim: After a high-frequency flop bet is called, the defender has already filtered weak hands, so the turn strategy must be rebuilt rather than copied from the flop.
interpretation: A wide flop bet is a one-street consequence of range advantage, not an automatic multi-street plan.
assumptions: The flop was bet at high frequency
exceptions: Some turn cards can create a new strong range advantage

claim: Out-of-position raising in a 3-bet pot requires a credible top-end value region; equity denial can support a valid raise candidate but cannot create the value foundation by itself.
interpretation: Check for top-end holdings before constructing a raise or low-SPR jam branch.
assumptions: Hero defends OOP in a 3-bet pot
Exact tier boundaries are not required
exceptions: Some textures remove the raise branch almost entirely
Exact combo selection remains solver-visual dependent
